rule_name: Section 115BAC: Concessional Tax Regime (New Tax Regime)
authority: Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) / Ministry of Finance
description: Section 115BAC specifies the New Tax Regime as default from FY 2023-24 onwards. For FY 2024-25, standard deduction is ₹75,000. Slabs: Up to ₹3L: 0%, ₹3L-7L: 5%, ₹7L-10L: 10%, ₹10L-12L: 15%, ₹12L-15L: 20%, Above ₹15L: 30%. Chapter VI-A deductions (80C, 80D, 24b) are disallowed except 80CCD(2).

rule_name: Section 80C: Deductions for Investments in EPF, PPF, ELSS, Insurance
description: Provides deduction up to ₹1,50,000 for specified investments including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Public Provident Fund (PPF), Equity Linked Savings Schemes (ELSS), Life Insurance Premiums, Principal Repayment of Home Loan, Tuition Fees, and 5-Year Tax Saver FDs under Old Tax Regime.
key_provisions: Applicable only under Old Tax Regime
Includes EPF, PPF, ELSS, Home Loan Principal

rule_name: Section 80D: Deductions for Health Insurance Premiums & Medical Checkups
description: Allows deduction for health insurance premiums paid for self, spouse, children up to ₹25,000 (₹50,000 if senior citizen) and additional ₹25,000 for parents (₹50,000 if parents are senior citizens). Preventive health checkup included up to ₹5,000 within cap.

rule_name: Section 24(b): Deduction for Home Loan Interest Paid
description: Allows deduction up to ₹2,00,000 per annum on home loan interest paid for a self-occupied property in Old Regime. For let-out property, maximum loss set-off against other income heads is capped at ₹2,00,000.
key_provisions: Pre-construction interest spread over 5 equal installments

description: Exempts HRA received by salaried individuals. Minimum of: 1) Actual HRA received, 2) 50% of basic salary for metro cities (Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai) or 40% for non-metros, 3) Rent paid minus 10% of basic salary. Only available in Old Regime.
key_provisions: Requires rent receipts and landlord PAN if rent > ₹1,00,000/yr

rule_name: Section 87A: Tax Rebate for Resident Individuals
description: Under Old Regime: Tax rebate up to ₹12,500 for taxable income up to ₹5,00,000 (net tax zero). Under New Regime: Tax rebate up to ₹25,000 for taxable income up to ₹7,00,000 (net tax zero), with marginal relief for incomes slightly exceeding ₹7,00,000.
key_provisions: Marginal relief enabled in New Regime

rule_name: Section 112A: Tax on Long-Term Capital Gains on Specified Equity Assets
description: LTCG on sale of equity shares or equity-oriented mutual funds held for > 12 months is taxed at 12.5% (post July 23, 2024 amendment) for gains exceeding ₹1,25,000 per financial year without indexation benefits.
source: Union Budget 2024 / Income Tax Act Sec 112A

rule_name: Section 111A: Tax on Short-Term Capital Gains on Specified Equity Assets
description: STCG on equity shares or equity mutual funds held for <= 12 months subject to STT is taxed at a flat rate of 20% (increased from 15% in Union Budget 2024).
source: Finance Act 2024 / Income Tax Act Sec 111A

rule_name: Section 80CCD(1B): Additional Deduction for NPS Investment
description: Provides an additional deduction of up to ₹50,000 for contributions to National Pension System (NPS Tier I account), over and above the ₹1.5 Lakh limit of Section 80C in Old Regime.
Deduction for employer contribution to employee's NPS account up to 14% of salary (Basic + DA) under New Tax Regime (10% under Old Regime). Allowed under BOTH Old and New Tax Regimes.
source: Finance Act 2024 / Income Tax Act Sec 80CCD(2)
key_provisions: Cap 14% of Basic under New Regime

description: Sec 80TTA allows deduction up to ₹10,000 on savings bank interest for individuals < 60 years. Sec 80TTB allows deduction up to ₹50,000 on all deposit interest (savings + FDs) for senior citizens (>= 60 years) under Old Regime.

rule_name: Section 54: Exemption of LTCG on Sale of Residential House Property
description: Exempts long-term capital gains from sale of a residential house if gains are reinvested in buying another residential house in India within 1 year before or 2 years after sale (or constructed within 3 years). Maximum exemption cap is ₹10 Crore.
key_provisions: Must be deposited in Capital Gains Account Scheme if unspent before ITR filing

rule_name: Section 54F: Exemption on Sale of Any Asset Other Than Residential House
description: Provides proportional capital gain exemption on sale of long-term assets (equity, land, gold) if net sales consideration is reinvested in purchasing a residential house in India. Maximum net consideration allowed for exemption calculation is ₹10 Crore.
key_provisions: Proportional exemption based on net consideration reinvested
Taxpayer must not own more than one residential house on date of sale

rule_name: Section 192: Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) on Salary
description: Employers are required to deduct TDS monthly on estimated annual taxable income of salaried employees based on income slab rates of employee's selected tax regime (Old or New).
source: CBDT Circular on TDS under Sec 192
key_provisions: Employee can declare regime choice to employer

rule_name: Section 208: Liability to Pay Advance Tax
description: Mandates payment of advance tax in 4 quarterly installments (15% by June 15, 45% by Sept 15, 75% by Dec 15, 100% by March 15) if estimated tax liability after TDS exceeds ₹10,000 for the financial year. Interest under 234B/234C applies on shortfall.
key_provisions: Senior citizens without business income exempt from advance tax
